description: This header file declares functions related to the Bmc2ComExecutor component, including creation, removal, and initialization functions for reader components within the Broadway Management Console v2.0 system.

methods.name: CreateBmc2ComeoReaderComponent
methods.description: Creates a Bmc2ComExecutor reader component with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: Bmc2ComeoReaderCOCreate
methods.description: Creates a Bmc2ComExecutor reader control object with specified contexts.

methods.name: Bmc2ComeoReaderCORemove
methods.description: Removes the specified Bmc2ComExecutor reader control object.

methods.name: Bmc2ComeoReaderCOInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the specified Bmc2ComExecutor reader control object.
